overview: Black plays 2...a6 instead of 2...d5, preparing ...b5, ...Bb7 and ...c5 and keeping the option of ...d5 later. White usually builds a big centre with Nf3, Bd3 and c3 or takes space with 3.c4. Black's queenside play and flexible centre make it a sound surprise, though White's extra space is real.

white_ideas.idea: Take a big centre with c4 (Three Pawn Attack) or c3 and Nf3, then play e5 to gain space.
Develop Bd3 and castle, aiming at a kingside attack against Black's slow development.

black_ideas.idea: Play ...b5, ...Bb7 and ...c5 to strike at the centre from the wing, with ...Nf6 and ...d5 later.
Meet 3.c4 with ...b5, offering the Sanky-George or St. George Gambit pawn for activity.

typical_structures.structure: White e4/d4/c3 centre against Black's e6/c5 with a fianchettoed bishop on b7.

character.notes: Main 3.Nf3 b5 4.Bd3 c5 line is a manoeuvring fight over the centre, neither forced nor especially safe.

gambit.notes: The gambits (3.c4 b5 4.cxb5 axb5) are sidelines; in the main line no material is offered.

soundness.notes: Considered playable; Black gets a flexible set-up but White's space is real.

structure.notes: Fixed d4/e4 centre against ...c5 strikes, a French-like asymmetrical centre with half-open files.

approach.notes: Played by a few strong players (Miles) but rare.

level.notes: Needs sound judgement of when to play ...c5 versus ...d5; little forcing theory.

sublines_that_differ.name: Sanky-George Gambit
sublines_that_differ.how: Black offers a pawn for queenside play after 4.cxb5 axb5 5.Bxb5.

sublines_that_differ.name: Three Pawn Attack
sublines_that_differ.how: White takes the whole centre, with a space-advantage fight.

character.reason: Unusual but not forcing or especially hard to break down.

gambit.reason: The main line offers no material; gambits are sidelines.

soundness.reason: Playable for Black though White holds a space edge.

structure.reason: Fixed centre pressed by ...c5 along a half-open file.

level.reason: Plans are clear but choosing between ...c5 and ...d5 needs judgement.

plans.reason: Black expands with ...b5, White holds central space.
